Folks — quick technical compliance note for the Acme thread:

1) SCCs vs. Schrems II: SCCs are our contractual baseline. For high-risk customers (healthcare), we should explicitly document supplemental measures that materially reduce transfer risk. Recommended set for this engagement:
   - KMS key residency in EU + envelope encryption where the root key is customer-controlled if requested.
   - No administrative access from US-based operations without documented justification and MFA plus privileged access approval & time-limited session tokens.
   - Network isolation: VPCs in EU with no cross-region replication unless explicitly enabled by customer.
   - Audit log retention: we can export audit logs to a customer-owned logging bucket in EU for the retention period they specify.

2) Evidence package: I will prepare a 1-page statement describing the above, a redacted SOC2 index, and the network diagram Sergio attached. For DocuSign SCCs, legal will need the counterparty name and signing authority; Sergio please confirm Acme legal contact.

3) Retention/deletion: we support retention windows and certified deletion of backups; for backups we can provide a deletion certificate showing the snapshot ids and timestamps. Deletion for account termination is handled by our Private workflow — timeline ~30 days for full crypto-key destruction if customer controls KMS.

I will review the draft SCCs and return comments by 11/23 EOD.

- Olga
